vocabulary.fit: parameters of a model are estimated on the seeds
vocabulary.select: a setting or a design choice is made on the seeds
vocabulary.confirm: a hold-out read once for a decision declared in advance
vocabulary.test: a fresh seed set read once for a frozen version
vocabulary.burned: results were read before a later decision was made; the seeds are development data for everything after
vocabulary.reserved: held back and never generated; changing this needs a deliberate edit of the registry
vocabulary.in_use: read for declared decisions and still clean for hypotheses whose design did not see those results
